name: Hridhaan Parikh
player_statement:
A complete player, Hridhaan Parikh has made a big mark in cricket. With 9 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 40*, with an average of 14.86 and a quick strike rate of 116.85. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 9 sixes and 5 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 8.0 overs, taking 5 wickets at an economy rate of 4.75. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
